stats.notes: No Common Data Set found: Colby does not post a recent one on colby.edu (the only copy located is for 2019-20), so these are IPEDS figures for the fall 2024 entering class. Applicants come from College Navigator; the admitted (1,360) and enrolled (628, all full-time) counts are from the NCES IPEDS 2025 Data Feedback Report, Figure 1 (chart data). College Navigator lists 7% admitted and 46% of admitted students enrolled. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled first-years who submitted scores (224 SAT, 98 ACT); SAT total, GPA, residency, early-decision and waitlist figures are not published in IPEDS and are left blank. Colby's own page (as of 2026-08-01, Class of 2030, fall 2026 entry) says 21,065 applicants, 8% admitted, middle 50% SAT 1430-1520 and ACT 33-34 for admitted students who submitted scores, with no counts of admits, so it is not used as the stats row. Undergraduate enrollment is the total undergraduate count, fall 2024 (2,412); the international count is not published in IPEDS as a number (Colby's profile says international students are 11%) so it is left blank.
